sentimento.text1: At 72 days until the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), this is the second consecutive day without a national voting-intention poll, and this time for a reason that has to be stated: [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) was registered with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) for publication today (BR-01166/2026, n=2,004, fieldwork July 22-24) and was not released before the market capture. Registration is not publication, and no number from it enters this panel until it comes out. The move of the day was Lula's, who broke through 61% for the first time since July 15 and closed at 61.50% (up 1.00pp, vol USD 7.63M), while Flávio remained virtually flat at 22.95% (up 0.10pp, vol USD 7.64M). The gap rose to +38.55pp, the largest since July 9 (38.60pp) and still below the cycle peak of +39.5pp (July 3).
sentimento.text2: The difference relative to July 23 is one of nature, not magnitude. Yesterday the gap widened by 2.10pp because Flávio fell; today it widened by 0.90pp because Lula rose, with his challenger flat. No triggering event is identified at the time of the movement, so the reading is market momentum and AFOS does not attribute the increase to any specific news. The second move was a rearrangement in the second-place-in-the-first-round sub-market: Flávio recovered 3.50pp, to 74.00%, and Renan fell 6.00pp, from 17.40% to 11.40%, while holding 67.00% in third place. The market reduced the hypothesis of Renan replacing Flávio in the runoff without moving his main price, which stood at 11.75% (down 0.10pp).
sentimento.text3: In politics, the fact of the day was documentary: reports on July 24 showed that the Progressive Union federation's neutrality, decided on July 22, came out of maneuvering by the Lula administration to pull the [centrão](/en/glossary#centrao) away from Flávio, with his running-mate slot stalled for the same reason, and that the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) is resisting without managing to reverse it (G1, Folha de S.Paulo, UOL, O Globo). Also on July 24, Javier Milei landed in Brazil to speak at the PL convention on July 25 (Folha de S.Paulo, CartaCapital), and the reconciliation with Michelle advanced to a joint video after the July 23 apology (Gazeta do Povo, Metrópoles). None of these facts had a clear price counterpart: Michelle fell 0.10pp, to 0.85%, and Flávio was flat. In the Senate seats book the PL fell 3.50pp, to 68.50%, and the [MDB](/en/glossary#mdb) fell 5.45pp, to 15.45%, with the caveat about the base that this number demands: the entire book has accumulated volume of USD 292 thousand against USD 115.55M in the presidential race. In the Renan case, the distortion against polling has not corrected, and it now carries through the weekend with no new poll to arbitrate it.
sentimento.direita: Flávio stanched the decline without reversing anything: he stood at 22.95% (up 0.10pp, vol USD 7.64M) after losing 2.10pp on July 23, and the gap over him grew anyway because the one who moved was Lula. The recovery showed up in one place only, second place in the first round, where he returned to 74.00% (up 3.50pp) with Renan falling to 11.40%. Outside the market, a day of opposing signals: the reconciliation with Michelle advanced to a joint video, after the July 23 apology, and Milei landed to speak at the July 25 convention (Folha de S.Paulo, Gazeta do Povo, CartaCapital), against the Progressive Union federation's neutrality, decided on July 22 and revealed on July 24 as government maneuvering, and the running-mate slot stalled for lack of the [centrão](/en/glossary#centrao) (G1, UOL), the corruption and money-laundering scope of the investigation targeting him, Eduardo and Vorcaro (Folha) and the remark in which he called the [PF](/en/glossary#pf) director-general a [pau-mandado](/en/glossary#pau-mandado) of Lula (Gazeta do Povo). The [PL](/en/glossary#pl) convention is tomorrow, July 25, still without a running mate.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula broke out of the range he had been locked in for three trading sessions and closed at 61.50% (up 1.00pp, vol USD 7.63M), his highest value since July 15. The gap over Flávio rose to +38.55pp, the largest since July 9, and this time by his own step: his challenger was flat. It remains below the cycle peak (+39.5pp on July 3). On political ground the day was good for him, with reports showing that the Progressive Union federation's neutrality, decided on July 22, came out of direct maneuvering by the administration to pull the [centrão](/en/glossary#centrao) away from Flávio (G1, Folha de S.Paulo, July 24), but there is no triggering event identified at the time of the price movement, so the rise is momentum and not a declared reaction.
sentimento.terceiraVia: The field did not move together, and the only one that rose was the one that had been flat yesterday. Zema more than doubled, from 0.45% to 0.95% (vol USD 4.52M), the largest relative variation in the book. Caiado gave back the previous day's gain and fell 0.30pp, to 1.75% (vol USD 5.11M), also retreating in third place in the first round, to 16.00%. Michelle retreated to 0.85% and Haddad was flat at 0.35%. Renan fell 0.10pp in the winner market and lost 6.00pp in second place in the first round. No new poll explains these movements: it is rotation internal to the market, on a day when price left the alternatives and went to the frontrunner. The contrast with polling persists: the field measures 3-7% of declared vote and is worth between 0.35% and 1.75%, except Renan, who is worth far more than he measures.
sentimento.polymarket: Lula 61.50% (up 1.00pp, vol USD 7.63M), Flávio 22.95% (up 0.10pp, vol USD 7.64M), Renan 11.75% (down 0.10pp, vol USD 8.45M), Caiado 1.75% (down 0.30pp, vol USD 5.11M), Jair 1.05% (flat, vol USD 5.23M), Zema 0.95% (up 0.50pp, vol USD 4.52M), Michelle 0.85% (down 0.10pp, vol USD 9.23M), Camilo 0.45%, Haddad 0.35% (flat, vol USD 6.33M), Tarcísio 0.15% (vol USD 13.57M, the largest individual volume in the book). Lula vs Flávio gap at +38.55pp, the largest since July 9 (38.60pp), below the cycle peak of +39.5pp (July 3). Sub-markets: second place in the first round Flávio 74.00% (up 3.50pp) and Renan 11.40% (down 6.00pp); third place Renan 67.00% (down 1.00pp) and Caiado 16.00% (down 0.50pp). Senate by seats: [PL](/en/glossary#pl) 68.50% (down 3.50pp), [MDB](/en/glossary#mdb) 15.45% (down 5.45pp), with accumulated volume of only USD 292 thousand in the entire book. [STF](/en/glossary#stf) impeach 3.55% (up 0.60pp, vol USD 83 thousand). Accumulated volume in the presidential race at USD 115.55M. Live July 24, 20:31 UTC, no degradation.

inss.text1: At 72 days until the election, the fiscal agenda remains at the center: the Senate left for recess without voting the Lula administration's priority bills, and Alcolumbre held back enactment of the [pauta-bomba](/en/glossary#pauta-bomba) while awaiting a conversation with Lula (Estadão). Four government provisional measures lapsed in July for lack of a vote (CNN), and Poder360 counts more than 20 defeats for Lula in Congress in his third term. The government responded through credit: a R$ 145 billion package in an election year, outside the fiscal framework (Estadão, Revista Oeste). At the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss), the fraud investigation remains under way, with people formally charged and evidence already documented in the earlier operations.
inss.text2: The market did not reprice fiscal risk against Lula: he rose. After three trading sessions stuck at 60.50%, he broke the range and closed at 61.50% (up 1.00pp), without any item on the fiscal agenda changing status during the day. The political data point of the day was documentary: reports on July 24 showed that the Progressive Union federation's neutrality, decided on July 22, was engineered by the government to pull the [centrão](/en/glossary#centrao) away from Flávio (G1, Folha de S.Paulo), and in the Senate seats book the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) fell 3.50pp. Neither the agenda stalled in Congress nor the R$ 145 billion credit package showed up as an identifiable price trigger in any direction.
inss.text3: [STF](/en/glossary#stf) impeach rose 0.60pp to 3.55% (vol USD 83 thousand), reacting with a one-day lag to the investigation authorized on July 23 by Mendonça, whose scope was detailed today as an inquiry into corruption and money laundering targeting Flávio, Eduardo Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro (Folha de S.Paulo, July 24). The volume base is orders of magnitude below the presidential race, so the reading remains institutional friction, not rupture.
inss.text4: On the electoral front, this was the second consecutive day without a published national voting-intention poll. [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) was registered for today (BR-01166/2026, n=2,004, fieldwork July 22-24) and was not released before the market capture: announcement stories circulated, no results, and no number enters here until publication. The most recent polling remains the Gerp of July 22 (n=2,000, fieldwork July 15-17, BR-05026/2026): first round Lula 38% vs Flávio 38%, with Renan Santos, Caiado and Zema at 3% each. Before that, on July 21: Indexa (BR-02904/2026) first round Lula 41% vs Flávio 30%, and Real Time (BR-09247/2026) first round Lula 40% vs Flávio 33% with Renan at 9%. The calendar ahead: JOTA on July 26 (n=6,000, fieldwork June 24 to July 19), [Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) on July 27 (n=2,000, fieldwork July 24-26) and [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel) on July 28 (n=5,000, fieldwork July 22-27, BR-08602/2026). Registration is not publication: the dates are those declared to the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), not confirmations of release.
inss.impactoLula: PoderData published on July 22 the reading on Lula's ratings most favorable in weeks (fieldwork July 18-20, n=2,500, IVR, 147 municipalities across 27 states, 2pp margin, no [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration because it does not measure voting intention): personal approval 46% vs disapproval 47%, with disapproval receding 3pp from the 50% of the previous week, and the poor-or-terrible rating of his performance falling from 47% to 37%, ten points in one week, in the post-tariff-shock period. The administration, however, remains disapproved by 51% against 43% approval. In the earlier readings: Indexa July 21 approves 49% vs disapproves 48%, Real Time July 21 approves 46% vs disapproves 50%, Genial/[Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) July 15 (n=2,004, in person, reliability 5) 48% vs 47%, the best level of the year (VEJA). Candidate rejection: Gerp July 22 Lula 47% and Flávio 46%; Indexa July 21 Flávio 50% and Lula 49%; Real Time July 21 Flávio 50% and Lula 48%.
inss.impactoGestao: Inflation expected by the market with the modal band at 5.00 to 5.49%, priced at 39.05%, followed by the 4.50 to 4.99% band at 26.05% ([Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket)). The center of the distribution remains above the target ceiling, a sign that the inflation market does not incorporate rapid convergence. Thin volume in this book, USD 77 thousand, so the signal is indicative, not firm.
inss.conclusao: At 72 days until the election, the second consecutive day without polling, and this time because the [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) registered for today was not released. The move came from Lula, who broke through 61% for the first time since July 15 and closed at 61.50%, with Flávio flat at 22.95% and the gap rising to +38.55pp, the largest since July 9. Unlike yesterday, the gap widened through a rise by the frontrunner, not a fall by the challenger, and with no triggering event identified at the time. In the sub-markets, Flávio recovered 3.50pp in second place in the first round and Renan fell 6.00pp there. The stalled fiscal agenda and the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) fraud continue not to turn into price against Lula. Without the Datafolha, the Renan case carries through the weekend without polling arbitration.

bancoMaster.text1: The Master case stopped being background wear and became a procedural fact with a name and an amount, and on July 24 it gained scope: the investigation will address corruption and money laundering and targets Flávio Bolsonaro, Eduardo Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro (Folha de S.Paulo, July 24). The day before, André Mendonça authorized the [PF](/en/glossary#pf) to open an inquiry into Vorcaro's transfers for the production of the film about Jair Bolsonaro's life, money given by the banker at the request of senator Flávio Bolsonaro (Correio Braziliense, Terra, Diário do Nordeste, Tribuna de Minas, July 23). In May, the site The Intercept revealed that Flávio asked Vorcaro for the money, with transfers of around R$ 61 million between February and May 2025. The PF wants to establish whether the funds were in fact applied to the film or whether part went elsewhere, including expenses of former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro in the United States. After the release of audio of a conversation between Flávio and Vorcaro, the senator denied having arranged any improper advantage and maintained that the funds transferred to the film were entirely private.
bancoMaster.text2: On the money trail, the case runs international: the [PF](/en/glossary#pf) called in Interpol to trace Daniel Vorcaro's assets in the United States and in Europe (G1). Estadão revealed a link between the [PCC](/en/glossary#pcc), [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) and a fugitive black-market currency dealer in a laundering scheme, and the investigation indicated that a firm connected to the Moraes family backed Master after the Caixa veto. The earlier development remains alive: the 2022 photograph of Flávio Bolsonaro beside Luiz Phillipi Machado de Moraes Mourão, known as Sicário, identified by the PF as an operator of the network linked to Vorcaro, who died in a PF cell in March 2026 and whom Flávio denies knowing. Ronaldo Caiado had been publicly demanding, since May, that Flávio explain his relationship with Vorcaro.
bancoMaster.text3: On July 23 there was a large price movement on the same day as the authorization of the inquiry, and on July 24 it neither deepened nor fully reversed. Flávio was virtually flat in the winner market, at 22.95% (up 0.10pp), and recovered 3.50pp in second place in the first round, from 70.50% to 74.00%, after having lost 7.50pp there the day before. What changed between one day and the next was not the case, but the political picture of the family: his apology to Michelle, made on video on July 23, was accepted by her that same night, and on July 24 came the information that the two are expected to record a video together (Gazeta do Povo, Metrópoles). Even so, Michelle's price fell 0.10pp on the same day, which argues against any reading of cause. AFOS records the calendar coincidence on both days and asserts causality on neither: the market does not declare a motive.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The Master case changed stage between July 23 and July 24: it left the terrain of reporting, entered that of formal investigation with Mendonça's authorization, and gained a scope of corruption and money laundering targeting Flávio, Eduardo and Vorcaro (Folha de S.Paulo, July 24). Flávio denies improper advantage, maintains that the money was private and raised his tone against the [PF](/en/glossary#pf), calling its director-general a [pau-mandado](/en/glossary#pau-mandado) of Lula (Gazeta do Povo). In the market, the sharp fall of July 23 did not deepen: he was flat in the winner market and recovered 3.50pp in second place in the first round. [STF](/en/glossary#stf) impeach rose 0.60pp, to 3.55%, with volume of USD 83 thousand. Real money continues to price friction, not rupture.

stf.toffoli: Toffoli remains isolated on the [STF](/en/glossary#stf) after the Master crisis, and the [PT](/en/glossary#pt) is testing a rapprochement with him. No new individual act captured on the day.
stf.moraes: No new individual act by Moraes captured on the day. The July 18 decision stands, which denied Javier Milei's request to visit Jair Bolsonaro under house arrest, read by Bolsonarism as silencing. The July 13 decision remains in force, which suspended Flávio for 90 days from visits to Jair, until mid-October, along with the request for the PGR to comment on the letter released by Flávio.
stf.gilmar: No individual act by Gilmar on the day. The recent joint vote stands (with Dino, Moraes and Zanin) that reduced restrictions on [penduricalhos](/en/glossary#penduricalhos).
stf.dino: No individual decision by Dino on the day. He remains a target of Bolsonarism after Flávio called him a communist justice, and the recent joint vote on [penduricalhos](/en/glossary#penduricalhos) stands.
stf.mendonca: He remains the justice of the moment. Rapporteur in the Vorcaro case, he authorized the Federal Police on July 23 to open an inquiry into the banker's transfers for the film about Jair Bolsonaro, made at Flávio's request, with amounts on the order of R$ 61 million between February and May 2025. On July 24 the scope of the investigation emerged: corruption and money laundering, with Flávio, Eduardo Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro in its sights (Folha de S.Paulo). No new individual act by him on the date.
stf.nexo: The [STF](/en/glossary#stf) is inclined to decide in favor of the Lula administration and block the [pauta-bomba](/en/glossary#pauta-bomba) approved by the Senate, a fiscal relief in an election year. Alcolumbre held back enactment while awaiting a conversation with Lula, and four government provisional measures lapsed in July. Bolsonarism's clash with the Supreme Court now enters the party convention phase, with Jair Bolsonaro imprisoned, Flávio suspended from visits until October and the [PF](/en/glossary#pf) inquiry into the film's financing already carrying a scope of corruption and money laundering. On July 24, Flávio called the PF director-general a [pau-mandado](/en/glossary#pau-mandado) of Lula (Gazeta do Povo), and a remark of his containing false data about the voting machines bothered diplomats (Folha de S.Paulo). The [PL](/en/glossary#pl) convention is tomorrow, July 25, still without a defined running mate.
stf.analise: [STF](/en/glossary#stf) impeach rose 0.60pp, to 3.55% (vol USD 83 thousand), reacting with a one-day lag to the inquiry authorized by Mendonça and to the corruption and money-laundering scope released today. The methodological caveat applies, and it is decisive here: accumulated volume is around USD 83 thousand, orders of magnitude below the USD 7.64M of the presidential race. On a base like that, half a point of variation does not sustain a narrative, and the movement itself may be an isolated order. What the market says, with that caveat, is what it always says: real money prices institutional friction, not rupture.
